captions.caption: A person walks past the "Saigon Sandwich" shop on a city street, then enters to order and receive a freshly made Vietnamese sandwich, which they hold up, revealing its colorful fillings of meat, vegetables, and herbs.
A person is holding and eating a fresh sandwich wrapped in paper on a paved outdoor surface, while pigeons forage nearby on the ground.
A person eats a Vietnamese sandwich while pigeons forage on the pavement nearby.
A person holds a fresh, herb-filled sandwich while standing on a paved surface, surrounded by a flock of pigeons that gather curiously nearby, some even approaching closely as if drawn to the food.
A person walks outdoors on a paved surface, holding a cup of dessert, while a corgi sniffs at something on the ground nearby and a pigeon stands nearby.

A person holds a plastic cup of a milky, bean-filled dessert, then uses a spoon to scoop and eat it while sitting on the ground, with a close-up shot showing them unwrapping a separate food item from a leaf.
A person sits outdoors and carefully unwraps a steamed, leaf-wrapped food item, revealing a soft, white interior, then uses a plastic fork to take a bite.

A person is eating a sandwich on the street, with a close-up shot of the food and their hand holding a fork. The scene then shifts to show the person's face and a suitcase nearby, with another person sitting in the background. The video ends with a credit screen thanking "Saigon Sandwiches" in San Francisco, CA.
